ov: مورتال كومبات (الإنجليزية: Mortal Kombat) هو فيلم فنون قتالية وفنتازيا وأكشن أمريكي قادم، الفيلم مبني على اللعبة الشهيرة مورتال كومبات ومن بطولة لودي لين، جو تاسليم، تادانوبو أسانو، جيسيكا ماكنامي، ميكاد بروكس، جوش لوسون، تشين هان وهيرويوكي سانادا. عرض الفيلم في 23 أبريل 2021.
plotEn:
In Japan in 1617, Hanzo Hasashi returns from collecting water to find his wife and son frozen to death, his home ransacked, and his allies, the Shirai Ryu ninja clan, slaughtered by the Chinese Lin Kuei assassin clan, led by cryomancer Bi-Han. After killing the attackers, Hanzo fights Bi-Han but is mortally wounded. He dies attempting to reach his hidden infant daughter, after telling Bi-Han to remember his face, and his soul is condemned to the Netherrealm. Lord Raiden, god of Thunder, later takes Hanzo's daughter to safety.
By 2021, Outworld has defeated Earthrealm in nine tournaments known as "Mortal Kombat." If Earthrealm loses a tenth tournament, Outworld will conquer it. An ancient prophecy foretells that the "blood of Hanzo Hasashi" will unite a new generation of Earthrealm champions and prevent Outworld's victory. To stop them before the tournament begins, Outworld sorcerer Shang Tsung sends his warriors to eliminate Earthrealm's champions, who are identified by a dragon mark.
Meanwhile, MMA fighter Cole Young and his family are attacked by Bi-Han, now known as Sub-Zero. Special Forces Major Jackson "Jax" Briggs rescues them and directs Cole to find his partner, Sonya Blade, while he stays behind to fight Sub-Zero. Sub-Zero freezes and destroys Jax's arms. Cole finds Sonya, who is interrogating Australian mercenary Kano about Mortal Kombat. The group is attacked by Shang Tsung's reptilian assassin, Syzoth, which scars Kano's right eye before they kill it together.
